notes.title: update v1.79
notes.content: Export to simple TXT file and to EPUB file (Kindle)

New features;

[list]
[*] the app can now automatically follow the operating system's colors theme
[*] "search in Google": select text and use right click button
[*] "reformulate in ChatGPT": select text and use right click button
[*] added "lowercase word and selection" to right-click button menu
[/list]

And some bug fixes and an improved PDF pagination
